entry_item.definition: v.t. a) To take, grasp, get hold of. b) To receive, obtain, gain, procure, acquire; to collect (as taxes); to buy; . to absorb, draw in; to adopt; to conceive. c) To remove, take off. d) As an auxiliary verb -preceded by imperfect or modal converbs describes the action as performance in the interest, on behalf, at the wish, or in the direction of the subject. e) As an auxiliary verb preceded by the perfect converb describes the action as momentary. f) The modal and perfect converbs of this verb preceded by the ablative case have the meaning of "beginning with, from. Since”

To take one's life, kill. See also b.
To take off one's hat or cap.
To attract to oneself; to win. (as supporters, etc.); to recruit.
